questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 9 observe about death?
options: The wise can escape it through their understanding
The same event happens to all, the righteous and the wicked
Only the wicked face it, while the righteous are spared
It comes only to those who have lived out long lives
questions.answer: The same event happens to all, the righteous and the wicked

questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 9 urge about whatever your hand finds to do?
options: Leave it for a wiser man to finish after you
Do only what is easy, since all toil is vanity
Do it with your might, for there is no work in Sheol
Set it aside and rest, for all striving profits nothing
questions.answer: Do it with your might, for there is no work in Sheol

questions.question: Ecclesiastes 9 says a living dog is better than a dead lion.
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your _____.
A living _____ is better than a dead lion.
